Trust Course Kit

Turn source material on a trust domain into a world-class interactive course, and prove it teaches.

v2 comes from building Who Owed Due Care?: 27 lessons that pair each concept in a CISSP training deck with a real, cited incident. Every number and quotation is traced to a source and re-checked after every edit round.

3.96 → 4.20simulated-learner experience (L1–L7)
79% → 89%steps fully understood
40 → 6low-motivation steps
0visual collisions (overlap check)

How a course gets made

  1. Check the source matches the ask. Build the fact base: split a case-rich source, or research one real incident per concept for a concept-only source.
  2. Write the design doc: the question framework and the boundary between neighbouring questions, what "stop" means here, the ladder, one device per lesson, three learner personas.
  3. Set every phrase in course.json and pass the config check.
  4. The lead writes an exemplar; parallel authors write the rest against the spec and briefs.
  5. Automated suite: facts, playthrough, taste, visual collisions. Then independent teaching review and a design critic.
  6. Simulated learners walk every step and explain it back. Fix what they name.
  7. Re-check facts on the changed text after every edit round. Re-measure, then a score-only panel.

What's inside

engine/Interaction blocks, real-object skins (now with sheet), the stop chain with collision-free connectors, question boundaries in the 8Q card, teasers, hints.
eval/Static eval, playthrough, taste checks, overlap check, learner-experience proxies, capture, rubrics for teaching, design and learner experience.
briefs/Research, source format, author, teaching review, design critic, learner fix, and fact re-check briefs.
tools/Suite runner, diff for fact re-checks, quote check, learner-round comparison, config check, aggregation, blind pairs.
examples/Gold exemplar, config templates, a cyber demo, and four lessons from the CISSP build with their fact base.

Using it

The trust-course-builder skill fetches these files into a fresh workspace and runs the full method. To fetch by hand, read this artifact's files by path, starting with README.md.
